### Why DO NOT SHIP
The Checkout and Form screens are core transactional flows, and both have confirmed broken state/logic (no total price, dead discount/redeem buttons, tier value silently discarded, no required-field validation). Orders is non-functional as a list. Diagnostics has both a guaranteed-failing status check and a genuine main-thread performance bug. These aren't edge cases — they reproduce on first interaction with default inputs."
